scenarios.startup: spawn begin to newer committed frame containing Enter send, ECHO disabled
scenarios.input: BB_TUI_INPUT_0123456789, no Enter; committed row contains exact marker
scenarios.paste: Ctrl-U; bracketed paste 4080 x bytes plus newline and BB_PASTE_TAIL, no Enter; exact tail in committed row

resize.endpoint: new committed frame contains exact draft in third-last row and closing border in second-last row

scenarios.resize_restore: restore original size; exact draft in third-last row and closing border in second-last row
scenarios.quit: Ctrl-U then Ctrl-D, normal exit zero, no force
scenarios.endpoint_clock: parent monotonic_ns after parsing read block and observing newer committed frame
scenarios.cache: ordinary OS caches; all trials retained; no warmup exclusion
